form: Picture book, 16 spreads + 3:4 cover + closing plate + narration (17 clips)
status: SHIPPED to books.garysheng.com (2026-08-08), listed, public token minted; PORTAL RECONSTRUCTION republished 2026-08-08 (Gary's direction); book-doctor healthy
cast: THE FOUNDER PARADISE ALLEGORY, a thesis on why hard work alone does not beat the closing light: a jungle of opportunity under a floating protopian island that nobody steers (even the winners are passengers), one portal per era hidden in the green that shrinks as founders pass through and as it stands open until it closes and leaves a ring of pale gold blossoms, myths written by the people still on the ground around the closed rings, stories from above arriving smudged, a prophet with a million followers whose broadcast lands only when the portal has shrunk too small for a crowd, and the island's keepers (never depicted, never named) parachuting small crates of smart orange compasses whose needles swing toward the live portal. NEW (portal reconstruction 2026-08-08): the-portal (visual-metaphor, code-drawn elevation, master/hidden/waning/closed; supersedes the-camouflaged-elevator, now archived). RENAMED: founder-heaven is founder-paradise (same locked plates; new drift lore). EXTENDED: the-orange-compass (smart, crated delivery pose, needle targets the portal). REUSE: maya (the seeker who works harder than everyone; crossover: she is the visitor who walked through the door at the end of nobody-labeled-the-door), chrissy (the finder who tells her friends first; her locked voice IS the title), engineer (the plain-spoken circle member), the-jungle, the-prophet (archetype, never a named real person). Aim discipline: one island only, never two in a sky; the island never appears before its spread-02 reveal, and it appears through the portal's opening ONLY where a scene asks by name (spread 13); smudged pages never carry readable letters; the prophet is warm and late, never a villain; the compass, crates and parachutes are unbranded (no lettering, no logo, clay-orange never neon) and the keepers stay off-page; capacity is NEVER scarce (the portal is still wide enough for every friend who comes; the scarcity is time); both era-rumors (opened wider than any before, closing faster than any has closed) are carried AS rumors, because rumor is the book's texture; the ending is urgency with warmth, never dread: keep looking. Refrain: "Finders tell their friends."
